languageParity: All frontend/public notices and labels must exist in HR and EN with identical substance.

aiOrchestrator.authorityHr: AI dodjeljuje zadatke, prati sve workere i 9 projekata, priprema izvješća i objavljuje samo dopuštene javne news kategorije.
aiOrchestrator.authorityEn: AI assigns tasks, monitors all workers and 9 projects, prepares reports and publishes only allowed public news categories.
aiOrchestrator.limitsHr: AI ne odobrava financijske, pravne, osobne i media-approval odluke te ne šalje kampanje ni masovne mailove.
aiOrchestrator.limitsEn: AI does not approve financial, legal, personal-data or media-approval decisions and does not send campaigns or mass emails.

hr: AI upravlja dnevnim zadacima workera i prati svih 9 projekata.
Workeri smiju pripremati, sažimati, spremati i objavljivati samo u dopuštenim javnim kategorijama.
Financijske, pravne, osobne i statusne tvrdnje idu u manual review.
Izvješća se spremaju u reporting queue i prikazuju operatoru.
Nema masovnog slanja, nema kampanja i nema javnog admin pristupa.
en: AI manages daily worker tasks and monitors all 9 projects.
Workers may prepare, summarize, save and publish only in allowed public categories.
Financial, legal, personal-data and status claims go to manual review.
Reports are stored in the reporting queue and displayed to the operator.
No mass sending, no campaigns and no public admin access.

dailyCycles.hr: AI jutarnji ciklus: dodjela zadataka, izvori, redakcije, prijave, rizici i plan objava.
dailyCycles.en: AI morning cycle: task assignment, sources, media outlets, applications, risks and publication plan.

dailyCycles.hr: AI srednji ciklus: izvršenje, queue objava, status kontakata, ručni review i blokade.
dailyCycles.en: AI midday cycle: execution, publication queue, contact status, manual review and blocks.

dailyCycles.hr: AI večernji ciklus: zatvaranje dana, objavljeno, čekanje, blokade i sljedeći koraci.
dailyCycles.en: AI evening cycle: day closing, published items, pending items, blocks and next steps.
